name: topdown
description: Town topdown walk with wall bumps, GB vs WSC on game_time ticks

excluded.why: the WSC screen is 224x144 and the GB screen is 160x144; scroll and screen-space values differ by design, so only world-space state is compared
the WSC viewport is wider, so actors can be active on only one side; activation is required to match only inside the GB viewport, which is the area both screens show

excluded.name: Pet Owner
excluded.why: its actor_30_update script uses VM_RAND; GB seeds from DIV_REG while WSC seeds from the vblank count, so the two random walks are intentionally unrelated
